cell_line.evidence: HAP-1 METTL13 KO cells were generated as a custom project by Horizon Genomics (formerly, Haplogen).
Cell lines for inducible expression of 3xFLAG-tagged eEF1A1 or eEF1A2 were generated using the Flp-InTM T-RExTM-293 system (Thermo Fischer Scientific).

To assess potential regulation of METTL13-mediated methylation in vivo, HeLa cells (ATCC and CCL-2) were incubated with media containing 4NQO (2.5 μM, 2 h), cycloheximide (50 µg/ml, 1 h) anisomycin (1 µg/ml, 1 h), or AdOx (10 μM, 48 h).

disease_state.evidence: inferred: HAP-1 WT and METTL13 KO cells were subjected to stable isotope labeling of amino acids in cell culture (SILAC) for quantitative MS analysis of peptides and proteins.
